coordinate_system: original image pixels: x rightward, y downward; origin top left
scope: 81 enclosed scribed cells; coating margins and cut extensions outside the ten-by-ten boundary network are excluded
numbering: row major: top left=0; left to right; then next row; bottom right=80
tracing: visual identification of cut corridors followed by smooth local ridge tracking separately in each source image; no enforced rectilinear mesh

images.orientation: original image; no rotation, resizing or geometric warping
